status: MCP shared deadline and ACK recovery component qualified; G4-016/G4-017 and whole Gate 4 remain in progress
qualification: Local macOS arm64; isolated loopback server, actual official MCP clients and native SDK observation; no provider account operations
behavior: A two-second verified admission delay followed by maximum requested event wait completes below ten seconds; the empty page is authoritative, has pending=true and its exact cursor is usable on a fresh wait.
Authentication remains bounded to five seconds; timeout releases admission, and a subsequent request authenticates normally. Existing 32-request admission and shutdown tests still pass.
An authenticated incomplete chunked body receives HTTP 504 at the shared ten-second cutoff; a fresh independent client can read its bound task afterwards.

A tool body decoded after the 9.5-second cutoff returns structured transport-uncertain with its authenticated task handle and reconcile=true. It does not pretend to complete a task or fabricate an inbox page; matching recovery produces one message.

A loopback proxy receives an actual accepted send response but withholds it from the caller. A new MCP connection repeats the same request_id and step_id and recovers the original structured receipt with exactly one visible message.

Validated logical IDs accompany tool outcomes; bearer plaintext and model authority selectors do not enter correlation metadata. Cancellation cancels the waiter, not an already dispatched durable store transaction.
All previous MCP discovery/version, host/origin, expiry/revocation, schema, operation parity, artifact/recall, listener lifecycle, capacity and streamed shutdown checks pass.

limits.scope: These bound server work from admission to response construction; slow reader/network delivery and arbitrary scheduler/build contention are not qualified performance guarantees.
limits.source_boundary: Targeted MCP integration and strict quality qualification only. Earlier whole-workspace evidence remains tied to its original source revisions.
limits.unchanged: No timer/size/capacity ceiling relaxed, no protocol/store schema or dependency patch changed, no Rudeless extraction/database or remote deployment/provider operation.

retained_attempts.result: The real independent MCP client measured 12.011505125 seconds for slow admission plus maximum wait, violating the ten-second requirement. Corrected by propagating one shared budget and retaining an earlier response reserve.
